data.text: User requested Pydantic AI for procurement. Add optional bounded Pydantic AI Python worker with Anthropic provider, structured needs and read-only search; retain current mock/Anthropic adapters and server-owned policy/approval/execution. Rank validated offers deterministically by configurable quality/landed price/delivery weights. Search snippets are discovery evidence, never authoritative executable prices or booking confirmations; default supplier execution stays simulated.
data.rationale: Explicit current user request expands sourcing and configurable automation while preserving existing safety/idempotency boundaries.
